headline: Morocco's defence administration and the French company Harmattan AI have signed a letter of intent to develop IRIFI, a long-range autonomous attack drone.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the headline said 'deal' but only a letter of intent was signed, with no value or timeline.
importance_line: It is an early step toward Morocco owning a long-range autonomous strike weapon, if it is ever built; it is only a letter of intent, with no price, date or production commitment, and the range is a stated figure.
summary: iAfrica reports that the letter, signed at the opening of the Marrakech Air Show, covers a drone with a stated range of up to 2,000 kilometres whose commanders set targets and mission limits before launch, after which it carries out the mission on its own. No contract value, timeline or production commitment has been disclosed, and Harmattan AI says key parts will be developed and built in Morocco, a split the report says has not been specified.
notes: Original item (Aviation Business Middle East) blocked; read iAfrica. Headline in the pool overstated: 'deal' is a letter of intent.
